name: us4-port-selection
description: 003 T043 [US4] — The two ports are interchangeable for the same input state (FR-013, Constitution VI). The install places no machine-wide executable, so the assistant selects the entry point from the host: `.specify/extensions/jira-mirror/scripts/bash/spec-kit-jira.sh` on macOS and Linux, `.specify/extensions/jira-mirror/scripts/powershell/spec-kit-jira.ps1` on Windows. That only helps if the two produce the same outcome, which is what this scenario pins: over one fixture carrying a registry exactly as `specify extension add` writes it, both ports must reach the same bridge outcome and leave a byte-identical repository tree — the registry included. 034 strengthened rather than weakened that last clause: the ports no longer merely refrain from writing the file, they never open it at all, so its bytes are untouched by construction.
